verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents an API with bearer-token auth, and says a global API token is valid 'for managing anything within Better Stack'. A team-scoped Uptime API token also manages Uptime resources, and an MCP server exposes telemetry to LLM workflows. That suggests broad programmatic coverage, but no evidence confirms parity with the UI, and probes found no published OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: explicit UI-to-API parity documentation, an endpoint reference covering incidents, schedules, escalation policies and status pages, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
